title: Chytrid Fungus Hit Hundreds And Many Amphibians Still Decline
hook: The worst amphibian disease toll is still unfolding in surviving species.
closing: Chytrid control matters because affected amphibian populations are still declining.
question: Which amphibians should recovery protect?

segments.say: Chytrid fungus affected 501 amphibian species. Its disease toll reaches across hundreds of species.
Thirty-nine percent of chytrid-affected species are still declining. The damage continues among survivors.
Chytrid fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. The country-level toll shows the disease remains widespread.
